key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large-language-model clinical AI system that connects live hospital data with external medical knowledge to support longitudinal musculoskeletal care across the full patient pathway.
clinical_relevance: In musculoskeletal disease, where decisions must evolve over months to years, this approach aims to improve individualized diagnosis, treatment planning, and rehabilitation management.
method: Built a specialist-validated benchmark from real-world EHRs covering 1,000 disease codes.
Used autonomous retrieval of imaging, lab, pathology, and order data to generate evidence-based recommendations.
Evaluated performance in reader studies, prospective complex-case testing, and an 8-month randomized deployment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports superiority over 81 orthopaedic physicians, improvement in full-chain management success by 10.6% in 1,870 complex cases, and a 9.7% increase in cumulative cases per bed during deployment.
watch_item: Results come from a specific musculoskeletal setting, so broader deployment may depend on local data quality, workflow integration, and safety validation.
